title: Branch reasons are not rendered in branch graph labels or tooltips

evidence.quote: The spec requires branch reasons as a label/tooltip in BranchGraph and HorizontalBranchGraph.
The branch pill renders branch.name and archived status, but not branch.reason.
The label model copies name/color/current state but drops branch.reason.
The rendered SVG label only outputs label.name.
Core tests confirm branch.reason is persisted and updated.

reasoning: Branch reasons are part of the branch data contract and the feature spec explicitly says they should appear in the branch tree. The core tests show the value is available, but both shared graph components discard it, so users who create a branch with a reason cannot see that context in the graph view.
reproduction: Create a branch with reason "Translation" and render either graph. The branch label/tooltip shows only the branch name, with no reason text.
recommendation: Include branch.reason in BranchGraph branch pill text or title and in HorizontalBranchGraph labels or title/tooltips, with minimal styling so it remains subtle.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing tests stop at core persistence; there is no @docgit/ui render test asserting branch.reason appears in either graph component.
suggestedRegressionTest: Render BranchGraph and HorizontalBranchGraph with a BranchRow containing reason: "Translation" and assert the reason is present in visible text or an accessible title/tooltip.
minimumFixScope: packages/ui/src/BranchGraph.tsx, packages/ui/src/HorizontalBranchGraph.tsx, and the corresponding UI styles/tests if visible label styling is added.
